meta.authorization: owner-stated; see Player_Animation_Project/ASSET_AUTHORIZATION.md; granting party and terms not on file
meta.axes: skeleton space: +Z = character forward, +X = character LEFT, +Y = up; metres, seconds
meta.composition: base = roles.<w>/<run|crouch>/idle clip at t = 0 + its layers (scratch AnimationTree); partial replaces its keyed bones (prop bones included); twin Add2 at 1 (phase-matched); FK
meta.grab_rule: junction frame by the source naming (A^B = from A to B): X^idle -> first frame, idle^X -> last frame (the graph's grab <-> draw seam, where the game moves the gun between holster and hand: the draw leaf is p-grab^idle-GUNOUT); gestures (switch hands, reload, pack stash) -> the frame farthest from the carry pose among frames with speed <= max(0.3 x peak, 0.25 m/s). hands.*.arrival = slowest frame on the grab side (first / last 40 %), a cross-check
meta.mirror: M: cases reflect every keyed local transform of the clip through the sagittal plane (L' = F(parent)^-1 L(partner) F(b), F(b) = G_rest(partner)^-1 diag(-1,1,1) G_rest(b)) over the unmirrored base
meta.model_offset: model = prop * Transform3D(Basis(Vector3.UP, PI), Vector3.ZERO) (Frontier socket offset; prop +Z = barrel / point)

validation.what: manual composition vs a full AnimationTree (Blend2 filtered partial + Add2 twin behind TimeSeek) at phases 0, 0.5, 1 of every unmirrored case

multi_pistol.note: err = distance between the hand point (palm + the prop bone's rest offset: where a held grip sits) and the carry point's grip point, at the clip's grab frame or, if smaller, the closest frame where the hand is slow (a clip segment that could be played to there and back); err_pass_min_m = closest pass at any speed (not usable on its own). M: = mirrored clip (needs a mirrored copy of the clip at build time). Verdicts: direct <= 0.05 m, close <= 0.10, approximation <= 0.20, else no
